context: Kenji and Ren reflect on their lifetime of work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: レン君、本当、長く、繋がってきた。
lines.en: Ren — we've really built something that's lasted.
lines.style: Warm, reflective opening. Voice soft and steady. A man appreciating time passed with quiet sincerity. No rush — letting each word land. Composure threaded through, genuine without strain.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Soft agreement, almost meditative. Matching Kenji's pace. Small voice that holds weight. Not echoing, but resonating — his own recognition of what's been shared.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Life is really strange, isn't it.
lines.style: Philosophical wonder, gentle tempo. Slight wondering lift on the question. Not cynical — almost marveling at how things unfold. Composure warm and present throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一緒に、ここまで、本当、宝。
lines.en: Being here together like this — it's treasure, really.
lines.style: Voice deepens with genuine feeling. Slow, deliberate. Not performing depth — just finding it naturally as he speaks. A moment of real vulnerability held steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 頑張ってきた、本当に、皆。
lines.en: We all tried so hard to get here. Really.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation, distributed across the phrase. Recognition without fanfare. Warm but grounded. A man acknowledging effort — his own and others' — with composure and real affection.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I'm grateful. Truly — all this time.
lines.style: Soft declaration, almost tender. Voice stays low, steady. Not performed gratitude — the kind that builds quietly over years. Gentle but present.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Closing note of warmth. Tempo patient and deliberate. The fullness of years reflected in those few words. Composure and sincerity held together — a man speaking what matters without apology.
